Product closure: limiting input 0.200 mol; product 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene as named and drawn is C8H9ClO2S, MW 204.67; theoretical 0.200 x 204.67 = 40.93 g; at the stated 84% that is 34.38 g; the printed mass is 28.6 g, which is only 69.9% of theory.
